name: kova-electron
description: Kova（扣瓦）— cross-platform desktop AI assistant built on Electron

scripts.build:renderer: node scripts/build-changelog.mjs && node scripts/build-fonts.mjs && bun run --filter desktop build && node scripts/sync-renderer.mjs
scripts.build: bun run build:sidecar && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:main
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter pi-runtime typecheck && bun run --filter desktop typecheck && bun run --filter kova-electron-main typecheck
scripts.verify:goal: bun run test && bun run --filter pi-edit-match test && bun run --filter kova-electron-main test && bun run test:desktop && bun run test:protocol && bun run test:runtime && bun run typecheck && bun run check:type && bun run check:patches && bun run check:versions && bun run check:changelog
